Contributing to priogridR

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for considering a contribution.

Reporting bugs

Before opening an issue, please search existing issues. A useful bug report includes:

  • a minimal reproducible example;
  • the expected and observed behavior;
  • the output of sessionInfo();
  • relevant spatial reference-system and PRIO-GRID configuration information;
  • small, shareable example data when possible.

Please do not post confidential or restricted data.

Proposing features

Open a feature request describing the research workflow, the desired public interface, and why existing functions do not cover the use case. Public functions should begin with pg_ and use snake case.

Pull requests

  1. Create a focused branch from main.
  2. Add or update tests for behavioral changes.
  3. Document exported functions with roxygen2.
  4. Update NEWS.md for user-visible changes.
  5. Run:
devtools::document()
devtools::test()
devtools::check()

Pull requests should leave R CMD check --as-cran without errors, warnings, or significant notes. Do not edit generated NAMESPACE or man/ files by hand; regenerate them with devtools::document().

Style

Use two spaces for indentation, explicit namespace calls such as terra::rast(), and descriptive argument names. Avoid changing the working directory or writing outside locations explicitly selected by the user.

Code of conduct

Participation in this project is governed by CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
